version_name: APP MOVED TO A NEW ID
changelog:
Due to Google moderation decision, we had to move the Play Store release to a new app ID.

To keep receiving updates, please install the new app. [Visit Play Store] button below will take you to the new app.

Before installing the new app, prepare a backup in this old app first in [Settings - Backup and restore]

After installing the new app, open it and restore your backup there.

We are sorry for the inconvenience.

Join our Discord server (link can be found on GitHub page) or send an issue on GitHub if you have any questions.
